glosses: A bicycle or motorcycle trick where the bike is ridden on the front wheel.
A crash in which the back wheel of the bicycle lifts off the ground and the cyclist is hurtled over the handlebars.

examples.text: Midway down a winding descent on a dry, rocky trail during a mountain bike race in Maui, I tried to avoid a large rock, jammed on my front brakes and went flying over the handlebars – a judo-style fall known as an "endo". […] To avoid future "endos" on precipitous descents, I stood with my weight over the rear wheel, gripping the seat with my thighs.
